hadith:
Pilgrims Prevented from Completing the Pilgrimage - Narrated Nafi`:

When `Abdullah bin `Umar set out for Mecca intending to perform Umra, at the time of afflictions, he said, "If I should be prevented from reaching the Ka`ba, then I would do the same as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did, so I assume the lhram for Umra as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) assumed the Ihram for Umra in the year of Hudaibiya."
message: When obstacles prevent us from our spiritual goals, we should remember the example of the Prophet (peace be upon him) who remained steadfast during the Hudaybiyyah journey—teaching us that sincere intention and patience are what matter most to Allah. Al-Ahqaf reminds us of Allah's guidance, and His name Ar-Raheem assures us that He is The Merciful One who understands our struggles and will guide us through every difficulty if we place our trust in Him.
name:
Ar Raheem - الرَّحِيمُ - The Merciful

The name Ar-Raheem originates from the Arabic root 'R-H-M', which denotes mercy and compassion. It signifies Allah's attribute of bestowing kindness and forgiveness to His creatures, highlighting the importance of mercy in the Islamic faith. Ar-Raheem often appears alongside Ar-Rahman, which also denotes mercy but encompasses a broader, universal aspect, while Ar-Raheem focuses more on a specific, heartfelt mercy towards the believers.
